description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Xerath''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|charges]] while being [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 0% – 40% (based on channel time) for up to 3 seconds to increase ''Arcanopulse's'' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] range over the first 1.5 to 1.75 seconds of the channel.
description.text: Active: Xerath charges while being slowed by 0% – 40% (based on channel time) for up to 3 seconds to increase Arcanopulse's  range over the first 1.5 to 1.75 seconds of the channel.

description2.raw: ''Arcanopulse'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge is [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]] or completes without reactivation, ''Arcanopulse'' is cancelled and refunds [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] half the mana cost.
description2.text: Arcanopulse can be recast within the duration. If the charge is interrupted or completes without reactivation, Arcanopulse is cancelled and refunds  half the mana cost.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Xerath''' becomes [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|unable to act]] for 0.528 seconds and afterwards fires a beam of energy in a line in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit.
description3.text: Recast: Xerath becomes unable to act for 0.528 seconds and afterwards fires a beam of energy in a line in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit.

leveling2.raw:

40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60

leveling3.raw:

70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 (+ 90% AP)

notes.text:
The onset of Arcanopulse's self- slow and first range increase is at a random interval of 0 to 0.25 seconds. The real time to maximum self-slow and range is thus 1.5 to 1.75 seconds.
The rectangle hitbox's minimum range is 0, right through Xerath's center.
Arcanopulse will not fire and deal damage if Xerath dies during the 0.528 seconds recast delay.(bug)
